correctness.rationale: From the cited primary Apéry formula and monotone greedy weight, the binary splitting criterion proves endpoint count 2t and exact plateau length s=h-f(t-1). All assumptions and bounds are explicit. Exhaustive residue-graph Dijkstra checks independently tested 119 pairs, 599039 residues; finite checks are corroborative only.

The displayed explicit formula and its arbitrarily large correction extend beyond those statements, notably m=127,n=7, and no covering formula appeared in recorded searches. Unindexed equivalences remain a risk.

value.rationale: The formula completes a literature-motivated exact Frobenius invariant for every odd coefficient in the standard Proth domain, going beyond two formerly known greedy-prefix regimes. Its correction is structurally motivated by a final weight plateau and is unbounded (h=2^(r+1)-1 gives correction r), not an arbitrary numerical slice.
